          if (settled) return;
          settled = true;
          clearTimeout(replyTimer);
          window.removeEventListener('message',onReply);
          signal.removeEventListener('abort',onAbort);
          frame.remove();
          if (error) reject(error); else resolve(text);
        }
        function onAbort() { finish(new Error('Tempo limite da biblioteca')); }
        function onReply(event) {
          if (event.origin !== url.origin || event.source !== frame.contentWindow) return;
          const reply = event.data;
          if (reply?.type !== 'bl3ss:media-reply' || reply.token !== token || reply.version !== packVersion) return;
          if (typeof reply.text !== 'string' || reply.text.length > packLimit) { finish(new Error('Resposta inválida')); return; }
          finish(null,reply.text);
        }
        if (signal.aborted) { onAbort(); return; }
        window.addEventListener('message',onReply);
        signal.addEventListener('abort',onAbort,{once:true});
        frame.addEventListener('load',() => {
          if (settled) return;
          clearTimeout(replyTimer);
          replyTimer = setTimeout(() => finish(new Error('A página de mídias precisa da versão com conexão Netlify')),8000);
          frame.contentWindow.postMessage({type:'bl3ss:media-request',version:packVersion,token},url.origin);
        });
        frame.src = url.href;
        document.body.append(frame);
      });
    }

    function importLibrary(text) {
      if (!text.includes(`<meta name="bl3ss-pacote" content="${packVersion}">`)) throw new Error('Biblioteca diferente desta versão');
      const images = Object.create(null), videos = Object.create(null);
      const imagePrefix = 'data:image/webp;base64,';
      const pattern = /<script type="application\/octet-stream" data-pack-key="([a-z0-9-]{1,96})" data-size="(\d{1,7})">([^<]+)<\/script>/g;
      let count = 0;
      for (const [,key,length,source] of text.matchAll(pattern)) {
        const clip = key.startsWith('wall-loop-');
        if (!(clip || key.startsWith('game-art-') || key.startsWith('music-art-'))) continue;
        const data = source.replace(/\s/g,'');
        if (data.length !== Number(length) || (!clip && !data.startsWith(imagePrefix))) continue;
        const bytes = clip ? data : data.slice(imagePrefix.length);
        const target = clip ? videos : images;
        if (!bytes.length || bytes.length % 4 || !/^[a-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/i.test(bytes) || Object.hasOwn(target,key)) continue;
        target[key] = data;
        count++;
      }
      if (count !== packCount || !wallOptions.filter(wall=>wall.animated).every(wall=>videos[`wall-loop-${wall.id}`])) throw new Error('Biblioteca incompleta');
      Object.assign(embedded,images); Object.assign(clips,videos);
    }
    function hydrateMediaImages() {
      // Atualiza apenas as imagens montadas. Busca, rolagem, foco e players ficam onde estão.
      for (const image of $$('img[data-pack-art]:not([src])')) {
        const url = embedded[image.dataset.packArt];
        if (!url) continue;
        image.src = url;
        image.hidden = false;
        const placeholder = image.nextElementSibling;
        if (placeholder?.matches('.catalog-fallback')) placeholder.hidden = true;
      }
    }
    function applyLibraryData(text) {
      importLibrary(text);
      hydrateMediaImages();
      setPackState('ready');
      syncWallpaperLoop();
    }
    async function loadMediaPack(retry = false) {
      if (packState !== 'idle' && !(retry && packState === 'failed')) return;
      // A cópia custom funciona até em arquivo local ou prévia sem rede.
      const bundled = $('#bl3ss-midia-interna');
      if (bundled) {
        setPackState('loading');
        try {
          applyLibraryData(bundled.innerHTML);
          bundled.remove();
          return;
        } catch { /* Se o editor cortar o bloco final, tenta a biblioteca externa quando permitida. */ }
      }
      if (location.protocol === 'file:' || inIsolatedViewer()) { setPackState('preview'); return; }
      const url = libraryAddress();
      if (!url) { setPackState('configure'); return; }
      if (!navigator.onLine) { setPackState('failed'); return; }
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(),40000);
      setPackState('loading');
      try {
        // Entre domínios, a biblioteca envia só os dados por postMessage pela origem autorizada.
        const text = url.origin === window.origin
          ? await readLibraryText(await fetch(url.href,{mode:'same-origin',credentials:'omit',redirect:'error',referrerPolicy:'no-referrer',signal:controller.signal}))
          : await readFramedLibrary(url,controller.signal);
        applyLibraryData(text);
      } catch { setPackState('failed'); }
      finally { clearTimeout(timeout); }
    }
    function loadRouteMedia() {
      if (welcomePending) return;
      const randomArt = currentRoute === 'random' && lastDraw && !embedded['game-art-' + lastDraw];
      if (currentRoute === 'games' || currentRoute === 'musica' || randomArt) loadMediaPack();
    }

    /* === Wallpapers enviados e configuração inicial === */
    const wallpaperById = id => wallOptions.find(wall=>wall.id === id) || wallOptions[0];
    const wallpaperPoster = wall => asset(wall.id === 'cidade' ? 'cidade' : `wall-art-${wall.id}`);
    let activeWallpaperLoop = '', wallpaperLoopURL = '', wallPlayPending = '';
    // A configuração abre em cada entrada; só as escolhas visuais são persistidas.
    let welcomePending = true, welcomeSnapshot = null, welcomeFocus = null;

    function selectWallpaper(id) {
      const wall = wallOptions.find(option=>option.id === id);
      if (!wall) return false;
      const theme = themes.find(item=>item.id === wall.theme);
      Object.assign(prefs,{wallpaper:wall.id,theme:theme.id,accent:theme.accent,accentCustom:'',surface:'',background:''});
      applyPrefs();
      return true;
    }
    function releaseWallpaperLoop() {
      if (!wallpaperLoopURL) return;
      const video = $('#wallpaper-loop');
      const url = wallpaperLoopURL;
      wallpaperLoopURL = activeWallpaperLoop = wallPlayPending = '';
      video.pause(); video.hidden = true;
      video.removeAttribute('src'); video.load();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }
    function syncWallpaperLoop() {
      if (performanceModeActive) { releaseWallpaperLoop(); return; }
      const video = $('#wallpaper-loop');
      const wall = wallpaperById(prefs.wallpaper);
      const gameOpen = currentRoute === 'minecraft' || !!$('#modal.dialog-player[open]');
      const shouldPlay = !gameOpen && wall.animated && document.documentElement.dataset.wallMotion === 'on';
      if (!shouldPlay) { releaseWallpaperLoop(); return; }
      if (document.hidden) { if (wallpaperLoopURL) video.pause(); return; }
      if (activeWallpaperLoop !== wall.id) {
        releaseWallpaperLoop();
        if (!video.canPlayType('video/webm; codecs="vp9"')) return;
        const source = clips[`wall-loop-${wall.id}`];
        if (!source) { loadMediaPack(); return; }
        try {
          const binary = atob(source);
          const data = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
          for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) data[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
          wallpaperLoopURL = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data],{type:'video/webm'}));
          activeWallpaperLoop = wall.id;
          video.muted = true;
          video.src = wallpaperLoopURL;
        } catch { return; } // O quadro estático continua como fundo.
      }
      const url = wallpaperLoopURL;
      if (!video.paused || wallPlayPending === url) return;
      wallPlayPending = url;
      video.play().then(() => {
        if (wallpaperLoopURL === url) video.hidden = false;
      }).catch(() => {
        if (wallpaperLoopURL === url && !document.hidden) video.hidden = true;
      }).finally(() => { if (wallPlayPending === url) wallPlayPending = ''; });
    }
    function renderWallOptions() {
      const studio = wall => {
        const thumb = `<span class="wall-thumb" aria-hidden="true"><img src="${escapeHTML(wallpaperPoster(wall))}" alt="" decoding="async" loading="lazy">${wall.animated ? `<span class="wall-play-mark">${icon('wave')}</span>` : ''}</span>`;
        return `<button type="button" class="wall-choice" data-wall-choice="${wall.id}" aria-pressed="${String(prefs.wallpaper === wall.id)}">${thumb}<strong>${escapeHTML(wall.label)}</strong><small class="studio-wall-kind">${wall.animated ? 'Animado' : 'Estático'}</small></button>`;
      };
      $('#wall-choices').innerHTML = wallOptions.map(studio).join('');
      $('#welcome-wall-options').innerHTML = wallOptions.map(wall => `<button type="button" class="welcome-wall" data-wall-choice="${wall.id}" aria-pressed="${String(prefs.wallpaper === wall.id)}"><img src="${escapeHTML(wallpaperPoster(wall))}" alt="" decoding="async" loading="lazy"><span class="welcome-check" aria-hidden="true">${icon('check')}</span><span class="welcome-wall-info"><strong>${escapeHTML(wall.label)}</strong><small>${wall.animated ? 'Animado' : 'Estático'}</small></span></button>`).join('');
    }
    function showWelcomeStep(step) {
      const dialog = $('#welcome-dialog');
      const first = step === 1;
      dialog.dataset.step = String(step);
      dialog.setAttribute('aria-describedby',first ? 'welcome-wall-intro' : 'welcome-performance-intro');
      $('#welcome-count').textContent = `POPUP ${step} / 2`;
      const heading = $('#welcome-title');
      heading.textContent = first ? 'Bem-vindo ao BlessHub4' : 'Ativar o modo de desempenho?';
      $('#welcome-wall-step').hidden = $('#welcome-wall-actions').hidden = !first;
      $('#welcome-performance-step').hidden = $('#welcome-performance-actions').hidden = first;
      $('#welcome-body').scrollTop = 0;
      if (dialog.open) heading.focus({preventScroll:true});
    }
    function openWelcome() {
      const dialog = $('#welcome-dialog');
      if (dialog.open) return;
      welcomePending = true;
      welcomeSnapshot = {...prefs};
      welcomeFocus = document.activeElement;
      showWelcomeStep(1);
      dialog.showModal();
      document.body.classList.add('welcome-open');
      $('#welcome-title').focus({preventScroll:true});
    }
    function finishWelcome(performance) {
      if (!welcomeSnapshot) return;
      if (typeof performance === 'boolean') prefs.performance = performance;
      else prefs = welcomeSnapshot;
      welcomeSnapshot = null;
      welcomePending = false;
      const dialog = $('#welcome-dialog');
      if (dialog.open) dialog.close();
      document.body.classList.remove('welcome-open');
      applyPrefs(); persist(STORAGE.prefs,prefs);
      if (currentRoute === 'minecraft' && mcRoom.index < 0) selectRoomGame(0);
      if (currentRoute === 'musica') syncCatalogPlayer();
      loadRouteMedia();
      if (welcomeFocus?.isConnected && welcomeFocus !== document.body) welcomeFocus.focus({preventScroll:true});
      if (document.activeElement !== welcomeFocus || document.activeElement === document.body) {
        $(currentRoute === 'minecraft' ? '#mc-title' : '#conteudo').focus({preventScroll:true});
      }
      welcomeFocus = null;
      if (currentRoute === 'chat') hubChat?.focus();
      if (currentRoute === 'friends') { friendsHub?.render(); friendsHub?.focus(); }
    }
    function setupWelcome() {
      const dialog = $('#welcome-dialog');
      $('#welcome-next').addEventListener('click',() => showWelcomeStep(2));
      $('#welcome-back').addEventListener('click',() => showWelcomeStep(1));
      $('#welcome-skip').addEventListener('click',() => finishWelcome());
      $('#welcome-perf-no').addEventListener('click',() => finishWelcome(false));
      $('#welcome-perf-yes').addEventListener('click',() => finishWelcome(true));
      $('#setup-again').addEventListener('click',openWelcome);
      dialog.addEventListener('cancel',event => { event.preventDefault(); finishWelcome(); });
      dialog.addEventListener('close',() => { if (welcomeSnapshot && !dialog.open) finishWelcome(); });
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',syncWallpaperLoop);
      window.addEventListener('pageshow',event => { if (event.persisted) openWelcome(); });
      openWelcome();
    }

    /* The live server is separate from a static deploy. The popup opened by the
       Netlify launcher inherits window.origin, even if location is about:blank. */
    /* Static front-end; only the server API is cross-origin. `site` is used for public links. */
    function onlineConnection(path) {
      let site = null;
      try {
        const origin = new URL(window.origin);
        if (origin.protocol === 'https:' || origin.protocol === 'http:') site = origin;
      } catch { /* no inherited origin in the file viewer */ }
      if (!site) {
        try {
          const current = new URL(location.href);
          if (current.protocol === 'https:' || current.protocol === 'http:') site = current;
        } catch { /* no public page URL */ }
      }
      if (!site) site = new URL('https://blesshub4.netlify.app/');
      const asset = value => apiURL(value);
      function explain(fallback) { return fallback; }
      return {usable:true, url:apiURL(path), mode:'cors', site, asset, explain};
    }

    /* === Presença anônima do site e da aba Minecraft === */
    function setupSitePresence() {
      const siteNode = $('#site-presence');
      const siteText = $('#site-presence-text');
      const minecraftNode = $('#minecraft-presence');
      const minecraftText = $('#minecraft-presence-text');
      const endpoints = [
        {node:siteNode, text:siteText},
        {node:minecraftNode, text:minecraftText},
      ].filter(item => item.node && item.text);
      const service = onlineConnection(`${API_BASE}/api/presence/pulse`);
      const visitorKey = 'bl3ss.site-presence.visitor.v1';
      const idPattern = /^[a-f0-9]{32}$/;
      function makeId() {
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(16);
        try { window.crypto.getRandomValues(bytes); }
        catch { for (let i=0; i<bytes.length; i++) bytes[i] = Math.floor(Math.random()*256); }
        return Array.from(bytes,byte => byte.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
      }
      let visitorId = '';
      try {
        visitorId = localStorage.getItem(visitorKey) || '';
        if (!idPattern.test(visitorId)) {
          visitorId = makeId();
          localStorage.setItem(visitorKey,visitorId);
        }
      } catch { visitorId = makeId(); }
      const sessionId = makeId();
      let inFlight = false;
      let queued = false;
      let disposed = false;
      let timer = 0;
      let timeout = 0;
      let controller = null;
      let lastSuccess = 0;

      function unknown() {
        for (const item of endpoints) {
          item.node.dataset.state = 'unknown';
          item.text.textContent = item.node === siteNode ? '— online' : '— online e jogando!';
        }
      }
      function applyCounts(value) {
        if (!value || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.online) || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.minecraft) ||
            value.online < 0 || value.minecraft < 0 || value.minecraft > value.online) return false;
        siteNode.dataset.state = 'online';
        siteText.textContent = `${value.online} online`;
        minecraftNode.dataset.state = 'online';
        minecraftText.textContent = `${value.minecraft} online e jogando!`;
        return true;
      }
      async function pulse() {
        if (disposed) return;
        if (inFlight) { queued = true; return; }
        inFlight = true;
        queued = false;
        controller = new AbortController();
        const requestController = controller;
        timeout = window.setTimeout(() => requestController.abort(),12_000);
        try {
          const response = await fetch(service.url,{
            method:'POST', mode:'cors', credentials:'omit', cache:'no-store',
            headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=UTF-8'},
            body:JSON.stringify({visitorId,sessionId,route:currentRoute === 'minecraft' ? 'minecraft' : 'other'}),
            signal:requestController.signal,
          });
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Presença indisponível.');
          const value = await response.json();
          if (!applyCounts(value)) throw new Error('Contagem de presença inválida.');
          lastSuccess = Date.now();
        } catch {
          if (!lastSuccess || Date.now()-lastSuccess > 45_000) unknown();
        } finally {
          window.clearTimeout(timeout);
          if (controller === requestController) controller = null;
          inFlight = false;
          if (queued && !disposed) { queued = false; void pulse(); }
        }
      }
      function sendLeave() {
        const payload = JSON.stringify({visitorId,sessionId,leave:true});
        try {
          const sent = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.sendBeacon &&
            navigator.sendBeacon(service.url,new Blob([payload],{type:'text/plain;charset=UTF-8'}));
          if (!sent) fetch(service.url,{
            method:'POST', mode:'cors', credentials:'omit', keepalive:true,
            headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=UTF-8'}, body:payload,
          }).catch(() => {});
        } catch { /* a expiração da sessão cobre navegadores sem beacon */ }
      }
      function start() {
        if (!disposed && timer) return;
        disposed = false;
        void pulse();
        timer = window.setInterval(pulse,20_000);
      }
      function stop() {
        if (disposed) return;
        disposed = true;
        window.clearInterval(timer);
        timer = 0;
        queued = false;
        controller?.abort();
        sendLeave();
      }
      if (!endpoints.length || !service.usable || inIsolatedViewer() || location.protocol === 'file:' ||
          (location.protocol === 'about:' && window.origin === 'null')) {
        unknown();
        return {routeChanged() {}};
      }
      window.addEventListener('pagehide',stop);
      window.addEventListener('pageshow',event => { if (event.persisted) start(); });
      start();
      return {routeChanged() { if (!disposed) void pulse(); }};
    }

    /* === BlessHub Chat: cada entrada começa com a sala vazia === */
    function setupHubChat() {
      const get = id => $(`#chat-${id}`);
      const ui = Object.fromEntries([
        'title','gate','login','name','admin-pass','join','login-note','retry','status','invite','invite-box','invite-url',
        'room','profile','leave','scroll','log','empty','jump','compose','text','send','message-count','room-note'
      ].map(id => [id, get(id)]));
      const joinLabel = ui.join.querySelector('span');
      const statusLabel = ui.status.querySelector('span');
      const inviteLabel = ui.invite.querySelector('span');
      const service = onlineConnection(`${API_BASE}/api/chat/`);
      // Links da prévia privada do sandbox não são convites públicos.
      const canInvite = service.usable && !/(^|\.)e2b\.app$/i.test(service.site?.hostname || '');
      const clock = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('pt-BR', {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'});
      const api = service.url;
      let scope = null;

      function element(tag, className, text) {
        const node = document.createElement(tag);
        if (className) node.className = className;
        if (text !== undefined) node.textContent = text;
        return node;
      }
      function status(state, label) {
        ui.status.dataset.state = state;
        if (statusLabel.textContent !== label) statusLabel.textContent = label;
      }
      function note(node, text = '') {
        node.textContent = text;
        node.hidden = !text;
      }
      function drawGate(current) {
        ui.join.disabled = !current.available || current.busy;
        ui.login.setAttribute('aria-busy', current.busy || current.probe ? 'true' : 'false');
        joinLabel.textContent = current.busy ? 'Entrando…' : 'Entrar no chat';
        ui.invite.hidden = !canInvite || !current.available;
      }
      function drawCompose(session) {
        const length = [...ui.text.value].length;
        ui['message-count'].textContent = `${length} / 500`;
        ui['message-count'].toggleAttribute('data-limit', length > 500);
        ui.text.disabled = !session?.ready;
        ui.send.disabled = !session?.ready || !!session.send || length > 500 || !ui.text.value.trim();
      }
      function clearFeed() {
        ui.log.replaceChildren();
        ui.scroll.scrollTop = 0;
        ui.empty.hidden = false;
        ui.jump.hidden = true;
      }
      function resetRoom() {
        clearFeed();
        ui.room.hidden = true;
        ui.gate.hidden = false;
        ui.profile.replaceChildren();
        ui.compose.reset();
        note(ui['room-note']);
        drawCompose(null);
      }
      function portrait(profile) {
        const initials = (Array.from(profile.name.trim())[0] || '?').toLocaleUpperCase('pt-BR');
        const figure = element('span', `chat-avatar${profile.admin ? ' is-admin' : ''}`, initials);
        figure.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        if (profile.admin && profile.avatar === '/chat-admin.png') {
          const image = element('img');
          image.src = service.asset(profile.avatar);
          image.alt = '';
          image.width = 33;
          image.height = 33;
          image.addEventListener('error', () => image.remove(), {once:true});
          figure.append(image);
        }
        return figure;
      }
      function identity(profile) {
        const line = element('div','chat-identity');
        const name = element('strong','',profile.name);
        name.dir = 'auto';
        line.append(name);
        if (profile.admin) line.append(element('span','chat-badge','Admin'));
        return line;
      }
      function drawProfile(profile) {
        const info = element('div','chat-profile-copy');
        info.append(element('small','','Você entrou como'), identity(profile));
        ui.profile.replaceChildren(portrait(profile), info);
      }
      function toBottom() {
        ui.scroll.scrollTop = ui.scroll.scrollHeight;
        ui.jump.hidden = true;
      }
      function atBottom() { return ui.scroll.scrollHeight - ui.scroll.clientHeight - ui.scroll.scrollTop < 42; }
      function drawMessage(data) {
        if (typeof data.profile?.name !== 'string' || typeof data.text !== 'string' || !Number.isFinite(data.time)) return;
        const nearBottom = atBottom();
        const article = element('article','chat-message');
        article.dataset.mine = String(data.mine === true);
        const body = element('div','chat-message-inner');
        const header = element('header');
        const time = element('time','',clock.format(data.time));
        time.dateTime = new Date(data.time).toISOString();
        header.append(identity(data.profile), time);
        const text = element('p','chat-message-text',data.text);
        text.dir = 'auto';
        body.append(header, text);
        article.append(portrait(data.profile), body);
        ui.empty.hidden = true;
        ui.log.append(article);
        // A única cópia das mensagens fica nesta interface e some ao sair.
        if (ui.log.childElementCount > 150) ui.log.firstElementChild.remove();
        if (nearBottom || data.mine) toBottom();
        else ui.jump.hidden = false;
      }

      const headersFor = token => token ? {Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`} : {};
      async function json(path, {body, token, signal, timeout = 6500} = {}) {
        const stop = new AbortController();
        const abort = () => stop.abort();
        if (signal?.aborted) abort();
        else signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, {once:true});
        const clock = setTimeout(abort, timeout);
        try {
          const options = {mode:service.mode, credentials:'omit', cache:'no-store', redirect:'error', signal:stop.signal, headers:{Accept:'application/json', ...headersFor(token)}};
          if (body !== undefined) {
            options.method = 'POST';
            options.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
            options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
          }
          const response = await fetch(api + path, options);
          const info = response.headers.get('content-type')?.startsWith('application/json') ? await response.json() : null;
          if (!response.ok || !info) {
            throw Object.assign(new Error(info?.error || 'Não foi possível conectar ao servidor do chat.'), {status:response.status});
          }
          return info;
        } finally {
          clearTimeout(clock);
          signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
        }
      }
      function signOff(token) {
        if (!token) return;
        void fetch(api + 'leave', {method:'POST', mode:service.mode, credentials:'omit', cache:'no-store', redirect:'error', keepalive:true, headers:{...headersFor(token),'Content-Type':'application/json'}}).catch(() => {});
      }
      async function probe(current, reason = '') {
        if (scope !== current || current.session || current.busy) return;
        current.available = false;
        current.probe?.abort();
        ui.retry.hidden = true;
        note(ui['login-note'], reason);
        if (!service.usable || typeof ReadableStream !== 'function') {
          status('offline','Fora do ar');
          note(ui['login-note'],'Este navegador não oferece suporte ao fluxo de leitura necessário para o Chat.');
          drawGate(current);
          return;
        }
        const controller = new AbortController();
        current.probe = controller;
        status('checking','Acordando o servidor…');
        note(ui['login-note'],'Acordando o servidor…');
        drawGate(current);
        try {
          let reachable = false;
          for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 3; attempt++) {
            if (scope !== current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
            try {
              const health = await json('health',{signal:controller.signal,timeout:65_000});
              if (scope !== current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
              if (health.ok !== true || health.service !== 'bless-chat') throw new Error();
              reachable = true;
              break;
            } catch {
              if (scope !== current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
              if (attempt < 3) {
                status('checking','Acordando o servidor…');
                note(ui['login-note'],`Acordando o servidor… nova tentativa em 5 s (${attempt + 1}/3).`);
                if (!await waitForAPI(controller.signal,5_000)) return;
              }
            }
          }
          if (scope !== current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
          current.available = reachable;
          if (reachable) {
            status('live','Disponível');
            note(ui['login-note'], reason);
          } else {
            status('offline','Fora do ar');
            note(ui['login-note'],'O servidor do Chat não respondeu após 3 tentativas. Tente novamente.');
            ui.retry.hidden = false;
          }
        } finally {
          if (scope === current && current.probe === controller) {
            current.probe = null;
            drawGate(current);
          }
        }
      }

      function enter() {
        if (scope) return;
        scope = {available:false,busy:false,probe:null,join:null,session:null,copyTimer:0};
        ui.login.reset();
        resetRoom();
        void probe(scope);
      }
      function stopSession(current) {
        const session = current.session;
        current.session = null;
        current.busy = false;
        current.join?.abort();
        current.join = null;
        if (!session) return;
        clearTimeout(session.retry);
        session.connection?.abort();
        session.send?.abort();
        signOff(session.token);
      }
      function exit() {
        const current = scope;
        if (!current) return;
        scope = null;
        current.probe?.abort();
        clearTimeout(current.copyTimer);
        stopSession(current);
        ui.login.reset();
        resetRoom();
        ui.invite.hidden = true;
        ui['invite-box'].hidden = true;
        inviteLabel.textContent = 'Copiar link da sala';
      }
      function focus() {
        const desktop = !window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches;
        const field = scope?.session?.ready ? ui.text : ui.name;
        (desktop && !field.disabled ? field : ui.title).focus({preventScroll:true});
      }
      function returnToLogin(current, reason = '', check = false) {
        if (scope !== current) return;
        stopSession(current);
        ui.login.reset();
        resetRoom();
        note(ui['login-note'], reason);
        drawGate(current);
        if (check) void probe(current, reason);
        else status('live','Disponível');
        if (!welcomePending) focus();
      }

      const activeSession = (current, session) => scope === current && current.session === session;
      function accept(current, session, data) {
        if (data.type === 'ready') {
          session.ready = true;
          session.failures = 0;
          current.busy = false;
          drawGate(current);
          if (!session.joined) {
            session.joined = true;
            drawProfile(session.profile);
            ui.gate.hidden = true;
            ui.room.hidden = false;
            note(ui['room-note'],session.wrongPass ? 'AdminPass incorreto. Você entrou sem a tag de admin.' : '');
            drawCompose(session);
            if (!welcomePending) focus();
          } else {
            note(ui['room-note']);
            drawCompose(session);
          }
        }
        if (session.ready && (data.type === 'ready' || data.type === 'presence')) {
          status('live',`${Math.max(1, Number(data.online) || 1)} online`);
        } else if (session.ready && data.type === 'message') drawMessage(data);
      }
      async function receive(current, session) {
        if (!activeSession(current, session)) return;
        const controller = new AbortController();
        session.connection = controller;
        let alarm = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 8500);
        let reader = null;
        let expired = false;
        try {
          const response = await fetch(api + 'stream', {
            mode:service.mode, credentials:'omit', cache:'no-store', redirect:'error', signal:controller.signal,
            headers:{Accept:'text/event-stream', ...headersFor(session.token)}
          });
          if (response.status === 401) { expired = true; throw new Error(); }
          if (!response.ok || !response.body || !response.headers.get('content-type')?.startsWith('text/event-stream')) throw new Error();
          reader = response.body.getReader();
          const decoder = new TextDecoder();
          let pending = '';
          while (activeSession(current, session)) {
            const {value, done} = await reader.read();
            if (done || !activeSession(current, session)) break;
            clearTimeout(alarm);
            alarm = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 24000);
            pending += decoder.decode(value, {stream:true});
            let sep;
            while ((sep = pending.indexOf('\n\n')) >= 0) {
              const packet = pending.slice(0, sep);
              pending = pending.slice(sep + 2);
              if (!packet.startsWith('data: ')) continue;
              const data = JSON.parse(packet.slice(6));
              if (data && activeSession(current, session)) accept(current, session, data);
            }
            if (pending.length > 12000) throw new Error();
          }
        } catch { /* fecha o stream e permite reconectar, sem repetir mensagens */ }
        finally {
          clearTimeout(alarm);
          controller.abort();
          reader?.releaseLock();
          if (session.connection === controller) session.connection = null;
        }
        if (!activeSession(current, session)) return;
        session.ready = false;
        clearFeed();
        drawCompose(session);
        if (expired || ++session.failures > 2) {
          returnToLogin(current, expired ? 'Sessão encerrada. Entre novamente para conversar.' : 'A conexão com a sala caiu. Entre de novo quando o servidor voltar.', true);
          return;
        }
        status('checking','Reconectando…');
        if (session.joined) note(ui['room-note'],'Conexão interrompida. Reconectando sem histórico…');
        session.retry = setTimeout(() => receive(current, session), 850 * session.failures);
      }

      ui.login.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const current = scope;
        if (!current?.available || current.busy || current.session) return;
        const name = ui.name.value.trim();
        if (![...name].length || [...name].length > 28) {
          note(ui['login-note'],'Use um nome de até 28 caracteres.');
          ui.name.focus();
          return;
        }
        current.busy = true;
        const controller = new AbortController();
        current.join = controller;
        note(ui['login-note']);
        status('checking','Entrando…');
        drawGate(current);
        const adminPass = ui['admin-pass'].value;
        ui['admin-pass'].value = '';
        try {
          const info = await json('join', {body:{name,adminPass}, signal:controller.signal});
          if (scope !== current) { signOff(info.token); return; }
          if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(info.token) || typeof info.profile?.name !== 'string') throw new Error();
          const session = {token:info.token, profile:info.profile, wrongPass:info.invalidAdminPass === true, ready:false, joined:false, failures:0, retry:0, connection:null, send:null};
          current.session = session;
          clearFeed();
          void receive(current, session);
        } catch (error) {
          if (scope !== current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
          current.busy = false;
          if (!error.status || error.status === 404 || error.status >= 500) {
            void probe(current, error.status === 503 ? error.message : 'Não consegui entrar na sala.');
          } else {
            status('live','Disponível');
            note(ui['login-note'], error.message || 'Não consegui entrar na sala.');
            drawGate(current);
          }
        } finally {
          if (current.join === controller) current.join = null;
        }
      });
      ui.retry.addEventListener('click', () => { if (scope) void probe(scope); });
      ui.leave.addEventListener('click', () => { if (scope) returnToLogin(scope); });
      ui.scroll.addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (atBottom()) ui.jump.hidden = true; });
      ui.jump.addEventListener('click', () => { toBottom(); ui.scroll.focus({preventScroll:true}); });
      ui.text.addEventListener('input', () => drawCompose(scope?.session));
      ui.text.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key !== 'Enter' || event.shiftKey || event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!ui.send.disabled) ui.compose.requestSubmit();
      });
      ui.compose.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const current = scope, session = current?.session;
        if (!session?.ready || session.send) return;
        const draft = ui.text.value, text = draft.trim();
        if (!text || [...text].length > 500) return;
        const controller = new AbortController();
        session.send = controller;
        note(ui['room-note']);
        drawCompose(session);
        try {
          await json('message', {body:{text}, token:session.token, signal:controller.signal});
          if (activeSession(current, session) && ui.text.value === draft) ui.text.value = '';
        } catch (error) {
          if (!activeSession(current, session) || controller.signal.aborted) return;
          if (error.status === 401) returnToLogin(current, 'Sessão encerrada. Entre novamente para conversar.', true);
          else note(ui['room-note'], error.status ? error.message : 'Não foi possível enviar. Tente de novo.');
        } finally {
          if (activeSession(current, session)) {
            session.send = null;
            drawCompose(session);
          }
        }
      });
      ui.invite.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const current = scope;
        if (!current?.available) return;
        const link = new URL(location.origin === service.site.origin ? location.pathname : '/', service.site);
        if (location.origin === service.site.origin) link.searchParams.set('tab','chat');
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(link.href);
          if (scope !== current) return;
          inviteLabel.textContent = 'Link copiado';
          clearTimeout(current.copyTimer);
          current.copyTimer = setTimeout(() => { inviteLabel.textContent = 'Copiar link da sala'; }, 1900);
        } catch {
          if (scope !== current) return;
          ui['invite-url'].value = link.href;
          ui['invite-box'].hidden = false;
          ui['invite-url'].select();
        }
      });
      window.addEventListener('pagehide', exit);
      window.addEventListener('pageshow', event => { if (event.persisted && currentRoute === 'chat') enter(); });
      return {enter, exit, focus};
    }

    /* === Play With Friends: login por aba do navegador, presença por seção === */
    function setupPlayWithFriends() {
      const $f = id => $(`#friends-${id}`);
      const service = onlineConnection(`${API_BASE}/api/friends/`);
      const api = service.url;
      const storageKey = 'bl3ss.friends.session.v1' + (service.mode === 'cors' ? `:${new URL(api).origin}` : '');
      const supported = service.usable && typeof ReadableStream === 'function';
      const client = Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16)), v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
      const storage = {
        read() { try { return sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey) || ''; } catch { return ''; } },
        write(value) { try { if(value) sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey,value); else sessionStorage.removeItem(storageKey); } catch { /* in-memory login */ } },
      };
      let token = supported ? storage.read() : '';
      if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(token)) token = '';
      let state = null, inside = false, suspended = false, connected = false, available = false;
      let transport = null, timer = 0, retries = 0, sequence = 0, probe = null, busyLogin = false, busyAction = false;
      let offset = 0, renderedInvite = '', renderedAlert = '', renderedRoster = '', renderedNames = '';
      let picking = null, mounted = null, capture = null, captureBusy = false, captureMoment = 0, shareRequest = null;
      let rtc = null, mediaIssue = '', sending = false, leaving = false, needRetry = false;
      let startedRoomKey = '', roomChatOpen = false, sidebarOpen = false;
      let readyPending = null, readySent = '', readyEndpointMissing = false;
      const el = (tag,cls,text) => { const e=document.createElement(tag); if(cls)e.className=cls; if(text!==undefined)e.textContent=text; return e; };
      const game = id => games.find(item=>item.id===id);
      const title = id => game(id)?.title || 'Jogo do BL3SS';
      function say(id,text='') { const e=$f(id); e.textContent=text; e.hidden=!text; }
      function action(text, fn, {primary=false, disabled=false, glyph=''} = {}) {
        const b=el('button',`btn ${primary?'btn-primary':'btn-secondary'}`); b.type='button'; b.disabled=disabled;
        if(glyph)b.innerHTML=icon(glyph);
        b.append(document.createTextNode(text)); b.addEventListener('click',fn); return b;
      }
      function person(container,name) {
        const mark=el('span','friends-initial',[...name][0]?.toLocaleUpperCase('pt-BR') || '?');
        mark.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
        const label=el('strong','',name); label.dir='auto';
        container.replaceChildren(mark,label);
      }
      function headers(auth) { return {'X-Friends-Client':client,...(auth ? {Authorization:`Bearer ${auth}`} : {})}; }
      async function json(path,body,auth=token, external,timeout=6500) {
        const c = new AbortController();
        const stop = () => c.abort();
        if (external?.aborted) stop(); else external?.addEventListener('abort',stop,{once:true});
        const limit = setTimeout(stop,timeout);
        try {
          const opts = {signal:c.signal,cache:'no-store',mode:service.mode,credentials:'omit',redirect:'error',headers:{...headers(auth),Accept:'application/json'}};
          if (body !== undefined) { opts.method='POST'; opts.body=JSON.stringify(body); opts.headers['Content-Type']='application/json'; }
          const response=await fetch(api+path,opts);
          const data=response.headers.get('content-type')?.startsWith('application/json') ? await response.json() : null;
          if (!response.ok || !data) throw Object.assign(new Error(data?.error || 'Não consegui conectar ao servidor.'),{status:response.status});
          return data;
        } finally { clearTimeout(limit); external?.removeEventListener('abort',stop); }
      }

      function pulse(background=false) {
        if (!connected || !token) return;
        const body={inside:!background && inside && !suspended,seq:++sequence};
        if (background) {
          void fetch(api+'pulse',{method:'POST',mode:service.mode,credentials:'omit',cache:'no-store',redirect:'error',keepalive:true,
            headers:{...headers(token),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(body)}).catch(()=>{});
        } else void json('pulse',body).catch(error=>{
          if (connected && (error.status===401 || error.status===409)) transport?.abort();
        });
      }
      async function checkServer() {
        if (probe || token || !inside) return;
        if (!supported) { say('login-note','Este navegador não oferece suporte ao fluxo de leitura necessário para Play With Friends.'); render(); return; }
        const c=new AbortController(); probe=c; render();
        let reachable=false;
        say('login-note','Acordando o servidor…');
        render();
        for (let attempt=1; attempt<=3; attempt++) {
          if (probe!==c || c.signal.aborted) break;
          try {
            const data=await json('health',undefined,'',c.signal,65_000);
            if (probe!==c || c.signal.aborted) return;
            if (data.service==='bless-friends' && data.ok===true) { reachable=true; break; }
            throw new Error();
          } catch {
            if (probe!==c || c.signal.aborted) break;
            if (attempt<3) {
              say('login-note',`Acordando o servidor… nova tentativa em 5 s (${attempt+1}/3).`);
              if (!await waitForAPI(c.signal,5_000)) break;
            }
          }
        }
        if (probe!==c) return;
        probe=null;
        if (c.signal.aborted) { render(); return; }
        available=reachable;
        if(!available) say('login-note','O servidor de Play With Friends não respondeu após 3 tentativas. Tente novamente.');
        else say('login-note');
        needRetry=!available;
        render();
      }

      function stopTransport() {
        clearTimeout(timer); timer=0;
        const c=transport; transport=null; connected=false; c?.abort();
      }
      function forget(reason='') {
        stopTransport(); token=''; storage.write(''); state=null; retries=0; sending=false; leaving=false;
        closePicker(); clearRoom(); unmountGame(); stopCapture(false); closeRTC();
        $f('login').reset(); say('login-note',reason); say('note'); render();
        if(inside && !available) void checkServer();
      }
      function onPacket(data) {
        if (data.type==='state') {
          const prev=state?.room, next=data.state.room;
          offset=(Number(data.serverNow) || Date.now()) - Date.now();
          if (prev && (prev.id !== next?.id || prev.revision !== next.revision)) {
            startedRoomKey='';
            if (capture) say('note',next ? 'O jogo mudou. Conectem os dois vídeos novamente para liberar o próximo jogo.' : '');
            stopCapture(false); closeRTC(); unmountGame();
          }
          if (prev?.id !== next?.id) { clearRoom(); if (next) say('note'); }
          state=data.state;
          if (!connected) { connected=true; available=true; retries=0; pulse(); }
          if (picking?.kind==='counter' && !picking.busy && (state.invite?.id!==picking.id || state.invite?.revision!==picking.revision)) closePicker();
          render(); syncMedia();
        } else if (data.type==='notice') {
          if (inside) say('note',data.text); else toast(data.text,'friends');
        } else if (data.type==='signal') signal(data);
        else if (data.type==='message' && state?.room?.id===data.room) addMessage(data);
      }
      async function openStream() {
        if (!token || suspended || transport || timer) return;
        const c=new AbortController(); transport=c;
        let clock=setTimeout(()=>c.abort(),8500), reader=null, reason=0;
        try {
          const res=await fetch(api+'stream',{mode:service.mode,credentials:'omit',cache:'no-store',redirect:'error',signal:c.signal,
            headers:{...headers(token),Accept:'text/event-stream'}});
          if (!res.ok || !res.body || !res.headers.get('content-type')?.startsWith('text/event-stream')) { reason=res.status; throw new Error(); }
          reader=res.body.getReader(); const decoder=new TextDecoder(); let buffer='';
          while(transport===c) {
            const {value,done}=await reader.read();
            if (done || transport!==c) break;
            clearTimeout(clock); clock=setTimeout(()=>c.abort(),16000);
            buffer+=decoder.decode(value,{stream:true}); let split;
            while ((split=buffer.indexOf('\n\n'))!==-1) {
              const line=buffer.slice(0,split); buffer=buffer.slice(split+2);
              if (line.startsWith('data: ')) onPacket(JSON.parse(line.slice(6)));
            }
            if(buffer.length>65536) throw new Error();
          }
        } catch { /* retain pending state and reopen the authenticated stream */ }
        finally { clearTimeout(clock); c.abort(); reader?.releaseLock(); }
        if (transport!==c) return;
        transport=null; connected=false; closeRTC();
        retries++;
        if (reason===401 || (reason===409 && retries>=3)) {
          forget(reason===409 ? 'Esse login está aberto em outra aba. Use outro nome.' : 'Seu login terminou. Escolha um nome para entrar outra vez.');
          return;
        }
        if(!state) say('login-note','Reconectando ao servidor…');
        render();
        if (suspended || !token) return;
        timer=setTimeout(()=>{ timer=0; void openStream(); },Math.min(5000,600*retries));
      }

      function invitationCard(container,p,overlay) {
        const incoming=p.to.id===state.self.id;
        const other=incoming ? p.from.name : p.to.name;
        const body=el('div','friends-inv-copy');
        const badge=el('p','eyebrow',p.kind==='switch'?'TROCA DE JOGO':incoming?'CONVITE RECEBIDO':'CONVITE ENVIADO');
        const headline=el('h3','',incoming ? `Jogar ${title(p.game)}?` : `Aguardando ${other}`);
        const sub=el('p','',incoming ? `${other} está te pedindo para jogar. ` : `Você propôs ${title(p.game)}. `);
        const d=el('span'); d.dataset.friendsCountdown=String(p.expires); sub.append(d);
        body.append(badge,headline,sub);
        const buttons=el('div','friends-actions');
        const disabled=!connected || busyAction;
        if(overlay) buttons.append(action('Ver convite',()=>go('friends',{focus:true}),{primary:true,glyph:'arrow'}));
        else if(incoming) buttons.append(action('Aceitar',()=>void respond(p,'accept'),{primary:true,disabled}),
          action('Mudar o jogo',()=>openPicker({kind:'counter', id:p.id, revision:p.revision, other, exclude:[p.game,state.room?.game]}),{disabled}),
          action('Recusar',()=>void respond(p,'decline'),{disabled}));
        else buttons.append(action('Cancelar convite',()=>void respond(p,'cancel'),{disabled}));
        container.replaceChildren(body,buttons);
        countDown();
      }
      function renderInvites() {
        const p=state?.invite?.expires > Date.now()+offset ? state.invite : null, inc=p && p.to.id===state.self.id;
        const key=p ? `${p.id}:${p.revision}:${connected}:${busyAction}` : '';
        const local=(inside && p) ? key : '';
        if (renderedInvite!==local) {
          renderedInvite=local;
          $f('invitation').hidden=!local;
          if(local) invitationCard($f('invitation'),p,false); else $f('invitation').replaceChildren();
        }
        const global=inside ? '' : (inc ? key : state?.room ? `${state.room.id}:room` : '');
        if (renderedAlert!==global) {
          renderedAlert=global; const alert=$f('alert'); alert.hidden=!global;
          if(global && inc) {
            invitationCard(alert,p,true);
            $f('announce').textContent=`Convite de ${p.from.name} para jogar ${title(p.game)}.`;
          } else if(global) {
            const body=el('div','friends-inv-copy'); body.append(el('p','eyebrow','PLAY WITH FRIENDS'),el('h3','',`Sala com ${state.room.peer.name}`),el('p','',`${title(state.room.game)} · Só vocês dois`));
            const row=el('div','friends-actions'); row.append(action('Voltar à sala',()=>go('friends',{focus:true}),{primary:true}));
            alert.replaceChildren(body,row);
          } else alert.replaceChildren();
        }
      }
      function countDown() {
        if (!state?.invite) return;
        const at=Date.now()+offset;
        for(const span of $$('[data-friends-countdown]')) {
          const seconds=Math.max(0,Math.ceil((Number(span.dataset.friendsCountdown)-at)/1000));
          const text=seconds ? `Expira em ${seconds} s.` : 'Expirado.';
          if(span.textContent!==text) span.textContent=text;
        }
      }
      function roster() {
        const list=connected && state?.inside ? state.online : [];
        const locked=!!state?.invite;
        const query=normalize($f('roster-search').value);
        const filtered=query ? list.filter(p=>normalize(p.name).includes(query)) : list;
        const key=JSON.stringify([list.map(p=>[p.id,p.name,p.busy]),locked,query]);
        if(renderedRoster===key) return;
        renderedRoster=key;
        $f('online-count').textContent=`${list.length} ${list.length===1?'online':'online'}`;
        $f('empty').hidden=!!filtered.length;
        if(query && !filtered.length) {
          $f('empty-title').textContent='Nenhuma pessoa encontrada';
          $f('empty-copy').textContent=`Não achei ninguém com “${$f('roster-search').value.trim()}”.`;
        } else {
          $f('empty-title').textContent='Ninguém disponível por aqui ainda.';
          $f('empty-copy').innerHTML='Peça a um amigo para abrir o BlessHub e entrar em <b>Play With Friends</b>.';
        }
        const rows=filtered.map(p=>{
          const row=el('div','friends-row'), identity=el('span','friends-person'); person(identity,p.name);
          const button=action(p.busy?'Ocupado':'Convidar',()=>openPicker({kind:'start',peer:p.id,other:p.name,exclude:[]}),{disabled:p.busy || locked,glyph:p.busy?'':'arrow'});
          button.dataset.friendsPeer=p.id; button.setAttribute('aria-label',p.busy?`${p.name} está ocupado`:`Convidar ${p.name}`);
          row.append(identity,button); return row;
        });
        $f('roster').replaceChildren(...rows);
      }
      function syncImmersive(room) {
        const active=!!inside && !!room;
        const root=document.documentElement;
        root.toggleAttribute('data-friends-room-active',active);
        if(!active) { sidebarOpen=false; roomChatOpen=false; }
        root.toggleAttribute('data-friends-sidebar-open',active && sidebarOpen);
        root.toggleAttribute('data-friends-chat-open',active && roomChatOpen);
        $f('room-chat').hidden=!(active && roomChatOpen);
        $f('sidebar-toggle').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(active && sidebarOpen));
        $f('sidebar-toggle').title=sidebarOpen?'Ocultar menu lateral':'Mostrar menu lateral';
        $f('chat-toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(active && roomChatOpen));
        syncFullscreenButton();
      }
      function syncFullscreenButton() {
        const b=$f('fullscreen');
        const active=!!document.fullscreenElement;
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(active));
        b.title=active?'Sair da tela cheia':'Entrar em tela cheia';
        b.querySelector('span').textContent=active?'Sair da tela cheia':'Tela cheia';
      }
      function render() {
        renderInvites();
        const self=state?.self, room=state?.room;
        syncImmersive(room);
        if (!inside) return;
        const entered=!!self;
        $f('login-panel').hidden=entered;
        $f('account').hidden=!entered;
        $f('active').hidden=!entered;
        $f('retry').hidden=!supported || !!probe || (token ? connected || retries===0 : available);
        $f('join').disabled=!available || busyLogin || !!token;
        $f('signout').hidden=!!room;
        if (!entered) return;
        const status=$f('link-state'); status.dataset.live=String(connected && state.inside);
        status.lastElementChild.textContent=connected ? (state.inside?'Online nesta aba':'Entrando na aba…') : 'Reconectando…';
        const names=`${self.id}:${room?.peer.id || ''}`;
        if(renderedNames!==names) {
          renderedNames=names; person($f('me'),self.name);
          if(room) { person($f('local-name'),self.name); person($f('remote-name'),room.peer.name); }
        }
        $f('lobby').hidden=!!room;
        $f('room').hidden=!room;
        if (!room) { roster(); return; }
        $f('room-title').textContent=title(room.game);
        $f('peer-status').textContent=room.peer.inside ? `${room.peer.name} está na aba` : room.peer.connected ? `${room.peer.name} está em outra seção` : `Aguardando ${room.peer.name} reconectar`;
        $f('switch').disabled=!connected || !!state.invite || !state.inside;
        $f('leave').disabled=!connected || leaving;
        $f('send').disabled=!connected || sending || !$f('message').value.trim() || [...$f('message').value.trim()].length>300;
        $f('share').disabled=captureBusy || (!capture && (!connected || !state.inside));
        $f('share').querySelector('span').textContent=capture?'Desconectar vídeo':captureBusy?'Aguardando permissão…':'Conectar vídeo';
        $f('share').setAttribute('aria-label',capture?'Desconectar seu vídeo do jogo':'Conectar seu vídeo do jogo, sem áudio');
        if(!startedRoomKey) prepareGame(room);
        updateGameLaunch(room);
        viewVideo();
      }
      function route(entering) {
        inside=entering;
        if (!inside) {
          startedRoomKey=''; roomChatOpen=false; sidebarOpen=false;
          if(document.fullscreenElement) void document.exitFullscreen().catch(()=>{});
          closePicker(); stopCapture(false); closeRTC(); unmountGame(); probe?.abort(); probe=null;
        }
        if (token) { if(connected) pulse(); else void openStream(); }
        else if(inside) void checkServer();
        render();
      }
      function focus() {
        const field=!token && !matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches ? $f('name') : $f('title');
        field.focus({preventScroll:true});
      }
      async function respond(p,move) {
        if(!connected || busyAction) return;
        busyAction=true; render();
        try { await json('answer',{id:p.id,revision:p.revision,action:move}); }
        catch(error) { say('note',error.status ? error.message : 'Não consegui enviar a resposta.'); }
        finally { busyAction=false; render(); }
      }
      function updatePicker(full=true) {
        const p=picking; if(!p) return;
        if(full) {
          const q=normalize($f('search').value.trim());
          const list=(library.catalog.length ? library.catalog : games).filter(g=>!p.exclude.includes(g.id) && (!q || g.search.includes(q)));
          const size=12, total=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(list.length/size));
          p.page=Math.min(p.page,total-1);
          $f('picker-count').textContent=`${list.length} ${list.length===1?'jogo':'jogos'}${q?' na busca':''}`;
          $f('page').textContent=`${p.page+1} / ${total}`;
          $f('pages').hidden=total<=1;
          $f('prev').disabled=p.page===0;
          $f('next').disabled=p.page>=total-1;
          $f('games').replaceChildren(...list.slice(p.page*size,(p.page+1)*size).map(g=>{
            const b=el('button','friends-game-choice'); b.type='button'; b.dataset.friendsGame=g.id;
            const outsideIframe=gameOutsideIframeIsolation(g);
            if (outsideIframe) b.setAttribute('aria-label',`${g.title} — ${OUTSIDE_IFRAME_LABEL}`);
            b.addEventListener('click',()=>{ if(picking!==p || p.busy)return; p.game=g.id; updatePicker(false); });
            const art=el('span','friends-game-art'); art.innerHTML=icon('game');
            const cover=gameArtwork(g);
            if (cover) { const im=el('img'); im.src=cover; im.alt=''; im.decoding='async'; im.referrerPolicy='no-referrer'; im.setAttribute('data-catalog-cover',''); art.append(im); }
            b.append(art,el('strong','',g.title));
            if (outsideIframe) b.append(el('small','friends-game-isolation',OUTSIDE_IFRAME_LABEL));
            return b;
          }));
        }
        for (const b of $$('[data-friends-game]',$f('games'))) b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.friendsGame===p.game));
        $f('selected').textContent=p.game ? title(p.game) : 'Nenhum jogo selecionado';
        $f('confirm').disabled=!p.game || p.busy;
        $f('confirm').textContent=p.busy?'Enviando…':'Confirmar';
      }
      function openPicker(info) {
        if(!connected || !inside || picking) return;
        const p=picking={...info, page:0,busy:false,game:info.kind==='start' ? (game('geometry-dash')?.id || games[0]?.id || '') : ''};
        const heading=$f('picker-context'); heading.textContent=info.kind==='start'?`Convidar ${info.other}` : info.kind==='counter'?`Propor outro jogo para ${info.other}` : `Trocar o jogo da sala com ${info.other}`;
        $f('search').value=''; say('picker-note'); updatePicker(); $f('picker').showModal();
        void loadMediaPack().then(()=>{ if(picking===p && !$f('games').contains(document.activeElement)) updatePicker(); });
      }
      function closePicker() { picking=null; if($f('picker').open) $f('picker').close(); }
      async function confirmGame() {
        const p=picking; if(!connected || !p?.game || p.busy) return;
        p.busy=true; say('picker-note'); updatePicker(false);
        try {
          if(p.kind==='counter') await json('answer',{id:p.id,revision:p.revision,action:'counter',game:p.game});
          else await json('invite',{kind:p.kind,game:p.game,peer:p.peer,room:p.room});
          if(picking===p) { closePicker(); say('note'); }
        } catch(error) { if(picking===p) { say('picker-note',error.status ? error.message : 'Não consegui enviar o convite.'); p.busy=false; updatePicker(false); } }
      }
      function unmountGame() {
        mounted?.probe?.abort(); mounted=null; $f('game-frame').replaceChildren(); $f('game-link').removeAttribute('href');
      }
      function prepareGame(room) {
        const g=game(room?.game), url=g && catalogURL(g.destination);
        const fallback=$f('game-fallback');
        fallback.hidden=!!url && !gameOpensInTab(g);
        const note=$f('game-fallback-note');
        if (note) note.textContent=gameOutsideIframeIsolation(g)
          ? `Este jogo está ${OUTSIDE_IFRAME_LABEL}; não é contabilizado como protegido pelo player incorporado. Use o link para abrir o destino.`
          : 'Esta fonte não roda no painel. Use o link abaixo para jogar.';
        const link=$f('game-link');
        if(url) link.href=catalogURL(g.fallback) || url;
        else link.removeAttribute('href');
      }
      function mountGame(room) {
        const key=`${room.id}:${room.revision}`; if(mounted?.key===key) return;
        unmountGame(); const g=game(room.game), url=g && catalogURL(g.destination);
        const fallback=$f('game-fallback'); fallback.hidden=false;
        if(!url) return;
        const part=mounted={key,probe:null};
        $f('game-link').href=catalogURL(g.fallback) || url;
        if (gameOpensInTab(g)) return;
        const frame=createGameFrame(document,g.title,gameFrameSandbox(url),{url,gameId:g.id,module:'game-player'});
        fallback.hidden=true; frame.src=url; $f('game-frame').append(frame);
        const c=part.probe=new AbortController(), timeout=setTimeout(()=>c.abort(),5200);
        void checkGameFrame(url,c.signal,location.origin,true).then(issue=>{ if(issue && mounted===part) { frame.remove(); fallback.hidden=false; const note=$f('game-fallback-note'); if(note) note.textContent=`O player não abriu esta fonte; ela está fora do isolamento do iframe. Use o link abaixo para abrir o destino.`; } }).finally(()=>clearTimeout(timeout));
      }
      function clearRoom() {
        startedRoomKey=''; roomChatOpen=false;
        $f('chat-log').replaceChildren(); $f('chat-form').reset();
        $f('room-chat').hidden=true;
      }
      function addMessage(data) {
        const log=$f('chat-log'), line=el('p','friends-chat-line');
        line.append(el('strong','',data.mine?'Você':data.from),document.createTextNode(`  ${data.text}`));
        log.append(line);
        if(log.childElementCount>80)log.firstElementChild.remove();
        log.scrollTop=log.scrollHeight;
      }

      /* WebRTC is negotiated only after a participant chooses to share a picture. */
      function track() { return capture?.readyState === 'live' ? capture : null; }
      function closeRTC() {
        const old=rtc; rtc=null; clearTimeout(old?.deadline); old?.pc?.close();
        const video=$f('video'); video.pause(); video.srcObject=null; video.hidden=true;
      }
      function videoReady(room) {
        const video=$f('video'), incoming=rtc?.incoming;
        return !!(room && room.video && room.sharing && room.peer.sharing && track() &&
          rtc?.room===room.id && rtc.wire===room.wire && rtc.pc?.connectionState==='connected' &&
          incoming?.readyState==='live' && !incoming.muted && video.readyState>=2);
      }
      function announceVideoReady(room,ready) {
        if(readyEndpointMissing || !room || !room.video || !inside || !connected) return;
        const key=`${room.id}:${room.wire}`, mark=`${key}:${ready}`;
        if(readyPending?.key===key) {
          if(readyPending.value===ready) readyPending.next=null;
          else readyPending.next=ready;
          return;
        }
        if(room.videoReady===ready) { readySent=mark; return; }
        if(readySent===mark) return;
        const request=readyPending={key,value:ready,next:null,sent:false};
        void json('ready',{room:room.id,wire:room.wire,ready}).then(()=>{
          request.sent=true; readySent=mark;
        }).catch(error=>{
          if(error.status===404) { readyEndpointMissing=true; viewVideo(); }
          else if(readySent===mark) readySent='';
        }).finally(()=>{
          if(readyPending!==request) return;
          readyPending=null;
          const current=state?.room;
          if(!inside || !connected || !current || current.id!==room.id || current.wire!==room.wire || !current.video) return;
          if(request.next!==null && request.next!==request.value) {
            readySent=''; announceVideoReady(current,request.next);
          } else if(!request.sent) readySent='';
        });
      }
      function updateGameLaunch(room) {
        const gate=$f('start-gate');
        if(!room || !inside) { gate.hidden=true; return; }
        const key=`${room.id}:${room.revision}`;
        if(startedRoomKey && startedRoomKey!==key) startedRoomKey='';
        const localVideoReady=videoReady(room);
        announceVideoReady(room,localVideoReady);
        if(!startedRoomKey && !welcomePending && localVideoReady && room.videoReady===true && room.peer.videoReady===true) startedRoomKey=key;
        const launched=startedRoomKey===key;
        gate.hidden=launched;
        if(launched) { if(!welcomePending) mountGame(room); return; }
        if(mounted) unmountGame();
        const localReady=!!(track() && room.sharing);
        const remoteReady=!!(room.peer.sharing && room.peer.inside);
        const heading=$f('start-title'), copy=$f('start-copy');
        if(!localReady && !remoteReady) {
          heading.textContent='Conectem os dois vídeos para começar';
          copy.textContent='Cada jogador precisa clicar em “Conectar vídeo”. O jogo só será liberado quando as duas imagens ao vivo estiverem conectadas.';
        } else if(!localReady) {
          heading.textContent='Falta conectar o seu vídeo';
          copy.textContent=`${room.peer.name} já conectou. Clique em “Conectar vídeo” para continuar.`;
        } else if(!remoteReady) {
          heading.textContent=`Aguardando ${room.peer.name}`;
          copy.textContent='Seu vídeo está pronto. O seu amigo precisa conectar o dele.';
        } else if(mediaIssue) {
          heading.textContent='O vídeo não conectou nesta rede';
          copy.textContent=mediaIssue+' Use “Reconectar vídeo” para tentar de novo.';
        } else if(readyEndpointMissing) {
          heading.textContent='Atualize o servidor do Play';
          copy.textContent='O Render ainda não reconhece a confirmação dos dois vídeos. Publique o server.mjs atualizado e reabra a sala.';
        } else if(!localVideoReady) {
          heading.textContent='Vídeos conectando…';
          copy.textContent='A partida só abre depois que as duas imagens ao vivo forem recebidas pelos dois jogadores.';
        } else if(room.videoReady!==true) {
          heading.textContent='Confirmando o seu vídeo…';
          copy.textContent='Sua imagem chegou ao vivo. A sala está confirmando que as duas transmissões estão prontas.';
        } else if(room.peer.videoReady!==true) {
          heading.textContent=`Aguardando ${room.peer.name} confirmar o vídeo`;
          copy.textContent='O seu vídeo está confirmado. A partida abre quando seu amigo também confirmar a imagem ao vivo.';
        } else {
          heading.textContent='Vídeos prontos…';
          copy.textContent='Os dois jogadores confirmaram as imagens ao vivo. Abrindo o jogo…';
        }
      }
      function viewVideo() {
        const room=state?.room, video=$f('video'), panel=$f('video-wait');
        const hasPicture=!!(connected && inside && room?.peer.sharing && rtc?.incoming && !rtc.incoming.muted && video.readyState>=2);
        video.hidden=!hasPicture; panel.hidden=hasPicture;
        const heading=panel.querySelector('strong'), desc=panel.querySelector('p');
        if(room) {
          if(!room.peer.inside) { heading.textContent=room.peer.connected?'Amigo em outra seção':'Aguardando reconexão'; desc.textContent='O vídeo volta quando os dois estiverem na sala.'; }
          else if(room.peer.sharing) { heading.textContent=mediaIssue?'Vídeo indisponível':'Conectando a imagem…'; desc.textContent=mediaIssue || 'Só o vídeo do jogo será recebido.'; }
          else { heading.textContent='Aguardando compartilhamento'; desc.textContent='O seu amigo precisa compartilhar a imagem do jogo.'; }
        }
        $f('video-retry').hidden=!room?.video || !mediaIssue || !connected;
        $f('video-note').textContent=hasPicture?'Ao vivo · sem áudio':'O áudio do outro jogador nunca é transmitido.';
        updateGameLaunch(room);
      }
      const currentRTC = r => rtc===r && inside && connected && state?.room?.id===r.room && state.room.wire===r.wire;
      // Video readiness changes after ontrack/onunmute; re-check the launch barrier when the first frame arrives.
      for (const event of ['loadeddata','canplay','playing']) $f('video').addEventListener(event,()=>{
        if (rtc && currentRTC(rtc)) viewVideo();
      });
      function mediaFailed(r,message='Não foi possível conectar o vídeo. Tente reconectar.') {
        if (currentRTC(r)) { mediaIssue=message; viewVideo(); }
      }
      function transmit(r,packet) { return currentRTC(r) ? json('signal',{room:r.room,wire:r.wire,signal:packet}) : Promise.resolve(); }
      async function setVideoTrack(r) {
        if (currentRTC(r) && r.sender) await r.sender.replaceTrack(track());
      }
      function startRTC(room) {
        closeRTC(); mediaIssue='';
        if(typeof RTCPeerConnection!=='function') { mediaIssue='Este navegador não tem suporte ao vídeo da sala.'; viewVideo(); return; }
        const r=rtc={room:room.id,wire:room.wire,caller:room.caller,pc:null,sender:null,incoming:null,queued:[],mail:Promise.resolve(),deadline:0};
        r.ready=(async()=>{
          const options=await json('ice',{room:r.room,wire:r.wire}); if(!currentRTC(r))return;
          const pc=r.pc=new RTCPeerConnection({iceServers:options.iceServers});
          pc.onicecandidate=event=>{ if(event.candidate) void transmit(r,{type:'ice',candidate:event.candidate.toJSON()}).catch(()=>{}); };
          pc.onconnectionstatechange=()=>{
            if(!currentRTC(r))return;
            if(pc.connectionState==='failed')mediaFailed(r,'O caminho de vídeo foi bloqueado pela rede. Tente reconectar.');
            if(pc.connectionState==='connected') { clearTimeout(r.deadline); mediaIssue=''; viewVideo(); }
          };
          pc.ontrack=event=>{
            if(!currentRTC(r) || event.track.kind!=='video') return;
            r.incoming=event.track;
            const video=$f('video'); video.muted=true; video.defaultMuted=true; video.volume=0;
            video.srcObject=new MediaStream([event.track]);
            const playback=video.play();
            if (playback && typeof playback.then==='function') void playback.then(()=>{ if(currentRTC(r))viewVideo(); }).catch(()=>{});
            event.track.onmute=event.track.onunmute=()=>{ if(currentRTC(r))viewVideo(); };
            viewVideo();
          };
          r.deadline=setTimeout(()=>{ if(pc.connectionState!=='connected')mediaFailed(r,'A imagem não conectou nesta rede.'); },18000);
          if(r.caller) {
            r.sender=pc.addTransceiver('video',{direction:'sendrecv'}).sender;
            await setVideoTrack(r);
            await pc.setLocalDescription(await pc.createOffer());
            await transmit(r,{type:'offer',sdp:pc.localDescription.sdp});
          }
        })().catch(()=>mediaFailed(r));
      }
      function signal(data) {
        const r=rtc;
        if (!r || r.room!==data.room || r.wire!==data.wire) return;
        r.mail=r.mail.then(async()=>{
          await r.ready; if(!currentRTC(r) || !r.pc) return;
          const pc=r.pc, packet=data.signal;
          if(packet.type==='ice') {
            if(pc.remoteDescription) await pc.addIceCandidate(packet.candidate);
            else if(r.queued.length<90) r.queued.push(packet.candidate);
          } else if ((packet.type==='offer' && !r.caller) || (packet.type==='answer' && r.caller)) {
            await pc.setRemoteDescription({type:packet.type,sdp:packet.sdp});
            for(const candidate of r.queued.splice(0)) await pc.addIceCandidate(candidate).catch(()=>{});
            if(packet.type==='offer' && currentRTC(r)) {
              const tx=pc.getTransceivers().find(t=>t.receiver.track.kind==='video');
              if(!tx)throw new Error();
              tx.direction='sendrecv'; r.sender=tx.sender; await setVideoTrack(r);
              await pc.setLocalDescription(await pc.createAnswer());
              await transmit(r,{type:'answer',sdp:pc.localDescription.sdp});
            }
          }
        }).catch(()=>mediaFailed(r));
      }
      function syncMedia() {
        const room=state?.room;
        if (!room?.video || !inside || !connected) { closeRTC(); mediaIssue=''; }
        else if (!rtc || rtc.wire!==room.wire || rtc.room!==room.id) startRTC(room);
        if (inside && connected && state?.inside && room && !shareRequest && room.sharing!==!!track()) {
          const req=shareRequest={}, sent=!!track();
          void json('share',{room:room.id,revision:room.revision,on:sent}).catch(error=>{
            if (inside && state?.room?.id===room.id && state.room.revision===room.revision && capture && error.status!==409) say('note','Não consegui anunciar a imagem. Pare e compartilhe novamente.');
          }).finally(()=>{ if(shareRequest===req)shareRequest=null; if(!!track()!==sent)syncMedia(); });
        }
        if(inside && room) viewVideo();
      }
      function stopCapture(update=true) {
        captureMoment++; captureBusy=false;
        const prev=capture; capture=null; prev?.stop();
        if(rtc) void setVideoTrack(rtc).catch(()=>{});
        if(update) { syncMedia(); render(); }
      }
      async function share() {
        if(capture) { stopCapture(); return; }
        const room=state?.room;
        if(!room || !inside || !connected || captureBusy) return;
        if(!navigator.mediaDevices?.getDisplayMedia || typeof RTCPeerConnection!=='function') {
          say('note','Para compartilhar imagem, abra o BlessHub em uma aba HTTPS no navegador do computador. A sala e o chat continuam funcionando.'); return;
        }
        const attempt=++captureMoment; captureBusy=true; render(); say('note');
        let stream;
        try {
          const crop=typeof window.CropTarget?.fromElement==='function' && $f('game-fallback').hidden;
          const marker=`bl3ss-game-${client}`;
          try { navigator.mediaDevices.setCaptureHandleConfig?.({handle:marker,exposeOrigin:false,permittedOrigins:[location.origin]}); } catch { /* optional browser feature */ }
          stream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({video:{displaySurface:'browser',width:{ideal:1280},frameRate:{ideal:24,max:30}},audio:false,
            preferCurrentTab:crop,selfBrowserSurface:crop?'include':'exclude',monitorTypeSurfaces:'exclude',surfaceSwitching:'exclude'});
          const picture=stream.getVideoTracks()[0];
          for(const t of stream.getTracks())if(t!==picture)t.stop();
          if(attempt!==captureMoment || !inside || state?.room?.id!==room.id || state.room.revision!==room.revision || !picture) { picture?.stop(); return; }
          let cropped=false;
          if(crop && typeof picture.cropTo==='function') {
            // Current-tab capture is cropped to the game panel; another tab stays as the user selected it.
            try { await picture.cropTo(await window.CropTarget.fromElement($f('local-stage'))); cropped=true; } catch { /* capture selected game tab */ }
          }
          if (picture.getSettings().displaySurface==='monitor' || (!cropped && picture.getCaptureHandle?.()?.handle===marker)) {
            picture.stop(); say('note','Abra o jogo em outra aba e selecione só a aba dele para compartilhar.'); return;
          }
          if(attempt!==captureMoment || !inside || picture.readyState!=='live') { picture.stop(); return; }
          capture=picture; picture.addEventListener('ended',()=>{ if(capture===picture)stopCapture(); },{once:true});
          if(rtc) await setVideoTrack(rtc);
          syncMedia();
        } catch(error) {
          if(attempt===captureMoment) { stopCapture(); say('note',error.name==='NotAllowedError' ? 'O compartilhamento foi cancelado ou bloqueado. Se estiver na prévia embutida, abra em outra aba e tente de novo.' : 'Não foi possível compartilhar. Tente selecionar a aba do jogo no navegador.'); }
          for(const t of stream?.getTracks() || [])t.stop();
        } finally { if(attempt===captureMoment) { captureBusy=false; render(); } }
      }

      $f('login').addEventListener('submit',async e=>{
        e.preventDefault(); if(busyLogin || token || !available)return;
        busyLogin=true; say('login-note','Entrando…'); render();
        try {
          const info=await json('join',{name:$f('name').value},'');
          if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(info.token))throw new Error();
          token=info.token; storage.write(token); awaitStarted();
        } catch(error) { say('login-note',error.status ? error.message : 'Não consegui entrar. Tente novamente.'); }
        finally { busyLogin=false; render(); }
      });
      function awaitStarted() { say('login-note','Conectando à sala…'); void openStream(); }
      $f('retry').addEventListener('click',()=>{
        if(token) { clearTimeout(timer); timer=0; void openStream(); }
        else { needRetry=true; void checkServer(); }
      });

      });
      $f('switch').addEventListener('click',()=>{ const r=state?.room; if(r)openPicker({kind:'switch',room:r.id,other:r.peer.name,exclude:[r.game]}); });
      $f('leave').addEventListener('click',async()=>{

        finally { leaving=false; render(); }
      });
      $f('picker-back').addEventListener('click',closePicker);
